descriptive_factorial_contrasts.scope: Descriptive conditional differences of first available complete fixed-site trough returns, including own basal requalification; not asymptotic convergence or a pure local truncation-error estimate.

reporting_limits: Two numerical levels per factor do not establish a converged period or limit cycle.
Each corner uses its own full-state requalified basal. Initial N is nominal; native event splitting changes the later mesh.
Fixed-site point and physical-patch activity, moving native peaks, vector phase and topology timing are separate readouts. Rac is not advected; vector phase is not material rotation or migration.
Native numerical exchange and uniform replacement are recorded separately from signed cap export; a dt-sensitive residual does not itself establish oscillation causality.
Challenged rings are not required to become stationary. Response windows are observations only; no endpoint-dependent early stopping or proposed mean-speed/cap law was introduced.
